exposure: expectant mothers' background antenatal ultrasound knowledge
outcome: state anxiety prior to antenatal ultrasound scan
cohort: A total of 500 expectant mothers (220 in the first trimester and 280 in the second trimester) applying for ultrasound scans were included.
finding: Age was the only significant factor affecting anxiety levels before ultrasound scan in pregnant participants, with higher age predicting lower state anxiety.
cross-section timing: prior to first trimester ultrasound scan and second trimester anomaly scan
